subject: Case narrative intake — 30-min discovery and recording consent
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Case narrative intake — 30-min discovery and recording consent

Hi Julia —

Thanks again for agreeing to share ClearPath’s experience with Redwood. We’d like to capture a short customer narrative that highlights the deployment, business outcomes, and any operational learnings your team is comfortable sharing.

Would a 30-minute remote session next week work? Proposed objectives (we’ll keep it tight):
- 5 min: quick intros & context
- 15 min: customer story — goals, rollout, impact (metrics if you can share)
- 5 min: lessons learned / best practices
- 5 min: approvals & next steps (photo/logo/release)

Two quick asks up front:
1) Can we record the session for internal note-taking and to produce a short written case study? You can opt out of publishing — we’ll send any final copy to you for sign-off.
2) Who should join from ClearPath (names & roles) so we can invite the right stakeholders?

If helpful, I drafted a short question list and will share a Google Doc for any edits prior to the meeting. Availability I have now: Tue 9/15 10:00–11:30am PT, Wed 9/16 1:00–4:00pm PT. If those don’t work, send a few slots that do and Ben will coordinate calendars.

Thanks — really appreciate your time.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.s@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Draft_Questions_GDoc_Link.txt (live doc link)

Thanks, Hannah —

We’re happy to participate. Recording is fine — I’ll confirm publishing permission with our legal team but we usually approve customer case studies after a quick review.

Attendees from our side:
- Julia Park — Head of Product (primary)
- Ken Liu — Director, AI Ops (technical lead)
- Priya Singh — Marketing (drops in for approvals)

We can do Wed 9/16 at 1:30pm PT. Please send a calendar invite. I’ll also attach our logo and a completed media release after I check with legal (will send later today).

—Julia
Julia Park | Head of Product
ClearPath Health
julia.park@clearpathhealth.com
